[7:54PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

The route from Otedola to Opic and back is currently smooth in both directions. 
Additionally, movement is flowing well on the stretches from Isheri Olowora, River Valley, Ogunnusi Road, Omole Junction, Excellence, Ogba, Caterpillar, and Odo Eran to Wempco. 

The return journey from Wempco through these routes is also clear. No major issues reported, and officials are actively managing traffic.

#FollowLASTMA
